pipeline.title: UDDI (cdc.darknetian.com)
pipeline.description: Normalize UDDI CEF events into the same dns_* / rcode / qname / qtype / dns_is_* shape the NIOS pipelines emit, so the Infoblox dashboard's pages (DNS / NXDOMAINs / SERVFAILs / Ops) work across both NIOS and UDDI sources.

rules.title: uddi_normalize_dns_fields
rules.description: UDDI CEF → normalized DNS fields. The Graylog CEF input plugin already parses the Infoblox CEF key=value pairs into top-level GELF fields (InfobloxDNSRCode, destinationDnsDomain, InfobloxDNSQType, deviceAddress, etc.). This rule just aliases them to the dashboard's expected field names and computes the dns_is_* booleans, matching the shape the NIOS pipelines produce.
